Have a great weekend and speak to you soon!

Adam

Hi Josh,
That's great, thanks very much!
On meeting next Thursday: we're meeting tomorrow afternoon so I'Il get back to you on a time soon after.
Speak soon,

Adam
From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Wednesday, June 2, 2021 3:42 PM
To: Fivenson, Adam <
>
Cc: Diana Parzik <[contact omitted]›; Bazley-Bethea, Princess ‹
LaRoque, Katie <
>; Meade, Luci <
Subject: Re: USAID/InterAction chat on disinformation
Hi Adam,
Thanks for the calendar invite. I'll get it on our leadership's calendar.
I think we should both be available to meet next Thursday, what times for work for you. I can see that Diana and I have
openings 10-11, 12-2, 3-5.
We can definitely provide some opening comments on the Primer and how USAID is approaching disinformation. We
would be happy to invite other colleagues working on this issue from other areas of USAID
Best, Josh
On Wed, Jun 2, 2021 at 2:06 PM Fivenson, Adam «
HiJosh,
> wrote:
Just a heads up that we'd like to go with Wednesday, July 14th from 2-4 PM. I'II send a calendar invite so you can
block the time off and forward to anyone else, and will add details to the description as we draw closer.
Would you and Diana be available to check-in next Thursday or Friday? By then we should have some of the
attendees confirmed and will be able to talk some details.
Two things to note in the meantime: first, following the draft agenda in the concept note, it would be great to
have USAID deliver some opening comments on the Primer itself and touching on your broader disinformation

portfolio & strategy. Second, if there are people from other bureaus (Global Health, BHA, GDL, Food Security,
etc...) who you think might benefit from being a part of this conversation, we're very open to that.
Speak soon!
Best,
Adam
From: Fivenson, Adam
Sent: Tuesday, June 1, 2021 12:15 PM
To: 'Joshua Machleder' <[contact omitted]>
Cc: Diana Parzik <[contact omitted]>; Bazley-Bethea, Princess ‹
LaRoque, Katie <
>; Meade, Luci<
Subject: RE: USAID/InterAction chat on disinformation

>
Thanks very much Josh, much appreciated.
We'll start reaching out to potential participants today and will let you know ASAP about finalizing the date/time.
Best,
Adam
From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Tuesday, June 1, 2021 11:04 AM
To: Fivenson, Adam <

LaRoque, Katie <

Subject: Re: USAID/InterAction chat on disinformation

Hi Adam,
Just consulted with our new director and the times/dates that work best for us are:
• Tuesday, July 13th 2 4 PM
• Wednesday, July 14th 2-4 PM
• Thursday, July 15th, 1-3 PM
Let me know which one you'd like to go with and I'll get it on our (and our director's) calendars.
Best,
Josh
On Fri, May 28, 2021 at 4:32 PM Fivenson, Adam <
Hi Josh,
> wrote:
We huddled on our side and would like to propose the following dates/times:
• Tuesday, July 13th 2-4 PM
• Wednesday, July 14th 10 AM to noon
• Wednesday, July 14th 2 4 PM
• Thursday, July 15th, 13 PM
Please let us know which (if any) of these dates/times would work for folks on your side. We plan to start
outreach to InterAction member organizations next week, and will ask potential participants to choose from
among the times that provisionally work for USAID.
Thanks for the well wishes, hope you enjoy it too!
Best,
Adam

From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>

Best, Josh

We'll reach out to members and get back to you with some options for dates ASAP.
Best,
Adam

It was nice speaking with you and Princess last week.
We've gotten our new director on board for opening up an event.
Could you propose 2-3 dates/times in July that would work well for you, and we'll try and sync up with her
availability?

Best,
Josh
On Tue, May 18, 2021 at 10:29 AM Fivenson, Adam <
> wrote:
Hi Josh, no worries and welcome back! I'm sending an invite for Friday from 11 to 12 noon. We probably
won't need the entire hour but we might need a bit more than 30 minutes to talk through some of the
details.
Speak soon!
Best,
Adam

Hi Adam,
I apologize for my delayed response -- the last week | was trying to catch up after 2 weeks of leave. I'd be
happy to discuss on Friday at any time between 11am and 1pm.
Best, josh
On Mon, May 17, 2021 at 11:05 AM Fivenson, Adam <
> wrote:
Hi Josh, hope you're well! Have you had a chance to look at the concept note? Let me know if you'd
like to discuss this week. I could meet Wednesday between 3-5 PM or Friday between 11 AM and 1
Best, Adam

From: Fivenson, Adam
Sent: Friday, May 7, 2021 4:45 PM
To: 'Joshua Machleder' <[contact omitted]>
Cc: Diana Parzik' <[contact omitted]>; Bazley-Bethea, Princess <

Subject: RE: USAID/InterAction chat on disinformation

Hi Josh,
Hope all is well!
We are pleased to share the concept note for InterAction's proposed feedback loop for the
Disinformation Primer.
Let us know what you think, and if you have any suggestions or changes. Happy to discuss over Zoom,
just let me know.
Best,
Adam
From: Fivenson, Adam
Sent: Tuesday, May 4, 2021 8:22 PM
To: 'Joshua Machleder' <[contact omitted]>
Cc: Diana Parzik <[contact omitted]>; Bazley-Bethea, Princess ‹

Subject: RE: USAID/InterAction chat on disinformation

Apologies for the radio silence from our end, lots going on here as always! We are working on a
concept and should be ready to share it next week.
Best,
Adam

We are meeting next Thursday afternoon to discuss specific ideas and will get back to you shortly

Best,
Adam

> wrote:
l'd like to include Princess Bazley-Bethea and Luci Mede, who run our Together Project, and Katie
LaRoque, who runs our DRG coordination group, both of which would be involved in the feedback
process.
Unfortunately the Monday time doesn't work, but would either Tuesday 2-3 PM or Thursday 1-2
PM work for you? Either time would work for everyone on our side. If so I can send out the invite
and will include Diana as well.
Thanks!

Adam

Josh

> wrote:

Best,
Adam

Great to hear from you and I hope you are doing well. Would you have some time to connect

Best, Josh

On Tue, Apr 6, 2021 at 5:37 PM Fivenson, Adam <
Hi Josh, hope you're well!
> wrote:
I'm just now coming up for air, after a challenging March. Let me know if you'd be available
to connect later this week or next week to discuss InterAction support around the Disinfo
Primer.
Best,
Adam
From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Friday, March 5, 2021 11:44 AM
To: Fivenson, Adam <
Cc: Diana Parzik <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: USAID/InterAction chat on disinformation
Thanks Adam! Looking forward to it
On Thu, Mar 4, 2021 at 5:37 PM Fivenson, Adam <
Hi Josh,
> wrote:
That's great, thanks very much. I've already started sharing on an individual basis. Let's
plan to circle back at the end March or beginning of April to discuss ideas around
feedback. In addition to the promotional value, the blog might be useful for kicking off
some creative engagement with NGOs centered around getting their feedback. I have
some thoughts and will be in touch!
Best,
Adam

From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Thursday, March 4, 2021 10:44 AM
To: Fivenson, Adam <
Cc: Diana Parzik <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: USAID/InterAction chat on disinformation
Hi Adam,
I'm attaching the version of the Primer which has been cleared for external distribution (and
without the label: For Internal Use Only).
Please feel free to share, post, blog about, etc. And let us know how we can help in the
distribution.
I would really like the opportunity - if/ when appropriate, to do some kind of presentation for
you and your members. Early April is actually a really good time for us as March is insane.
Thanks much!!!
Best, Josh
On Wed, Mar 3, 2021 at 4:41 PM Fivenson, Adam <
Hi Josh,
> wrote:
Thanks for that, I'll be sure to mention that the public distribution strategy is still
pending, but for technical purposes it will be very useful.
On a blog & round of feedback for the Primer, happy to discuss any time. That said, it
might not be until in early April, after the current sprint on our disinfo toolkit, that l'Il
have bandwidth to write and organize.
Also, I did reach out Lisa Schirch, who runs the Alliance for Peacebuilding's new social
media working group and she's happy to add you both to their email list for updates
and future events. They've also got Nicole Patierno and Richard Morgan from
USAID/DRG on there. I'II send an email intro now.
Speak soon!
Best,

Adam
From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Tuesday, March 2, 2021 6:44 PM
To: Fivenson, Adam <
Cc: Diana Parzik <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: USAID/InterAction chat on disinformation
Hi Adam,
Please feel free to share on an individual basis for now. I have a meeting tomorrow with
our communications folks and will be talking about a distribution strategy. Actually
promoting it on the Interaction blog would be great -- and I'il let her know that this would
be a great opportunity for us. We also should discuss feedback -- this would be incredibly
useful as we are going to start thinking this summer about the next edition (based on user
Thanks so much!
Best,
Josh
On Tue, Mar 2, 2021 at 5:25 PM Fivenson, Adam <
Hi Josh,
> wrote:
Thanks so much for sharing this, l appreciate it.
I just gave it a quick scan and can say that there's so much useful content in here,
particularly the strategies and recommendations in sections 6 & 7. I'm also enjoying
seeing some of the same research I'm citing from the We Are Social & Pew reports in
section 2-good to know we're thinking about the same global trends.
Would it be alright for me to share this on an individual basis for now? I have a few
chats coming up with InterAction Member orgs' disinformation specialists and it

would be great to be able to pass this along.
In terms of distribution strategy, we would be happy to write up a blog about it and
host a discussion/ feedback session with InterAction members come April/May, if it
would be helpful.
Best,
Adam
From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Tuesday, March 2, 2021 3:58 PM
To: Fivenson, Adam <
Cc: Diana Parzik <[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: USAID/InterAction chat on disinformation
Hi Adam,
Just wanted to share this with you. It's USAID's Disinformation Primer, and it was just
cleared for external circulation.
We haven't yet come up with a distribution strategy, and will have one soon, I'm sure.
But thought you might be interested in having a copy.
Best, Josh

Hi Adam,
Sorry for the delay in responding. Thursday at 3:30 would be great.
Best,
Josh
On Thu, Feb 18, 2021 at 9:25 PM Fivenson, Adam <
wrote:
Hi Michelle, nice to reconnect and thanks for the intros, much appreciated!
Josh it's great to meet you and the same goes for Diana.
How does next Wednesday 2/24 2-3 PM look for you? I could also do Thursday
1-2 PM or 3:30 to 4:30.
Speak soon!
Best,
Adam
From: Joshua Machleder <[contact omitted]>
Sent: Thursday, February 18, 2021 4:24 PM
To: Michelle Parker <[contact omitted]>

Cc: Fivenson, Adam <
<[contact omitted]>
Subject: Re: Disinformation contact?
>; Diana Parzik
Hi Adam, nice to meet you, Thanks, Michelle for the introduction.
I'd be happy to talk -- we're working on coming up with a more coherent strategy
here, and I'm really interested in hearing what you and your partners are thinking.
Copying my colleague, Diana.
Please let me know when are some good times to chat.
Best, Josh
On Thu, Feb 18, 2021 at 2:49 PM Michelle Parker <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Adam,
Great to hear from you! It's been ages. I hope you and yours are well.
I'd like to introduce you to Josh Machleder, Senior Media and Internet Freedom
Advisor in the Democracy, Rights, and Governance Center. He is our Agency's
lead on Disinformation and is best placed to engage with InterAction and its
members on this critical issue.
Josh,
I'd like to introduce Adam Fivenson, who has been a fantastic sounding board
and partner in convening InterAction members to discuss and provide feedback
on our Digital Strategy work.
Take care,
Michelle
On Wed, Feb 17, 2021 at 4:45 PM Fivenson, Adam
> wrote:
Hi Michelle,
Hope you're doing well and staying warm!
InterAction and our member NGOs are increasingly concerned about the
impact of disinformation on democracy and on development and
humanitarian programming, so we're putting together a broad coalition of
private sector, civil society, government and multi-lateral actors to share best
practices, strategize, and coordinate action. I know that the Digital Strategy
mentioned that USAID is thinking about disinformation, would you be able to

put me in touch with the person or team working on this challenge? Thanks
very much!
Best,
Adam
